top.title: US carries out self-defense strike on IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island
top.rewrite: US carries out self-defense strike on IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island
top.summary: Two US military officials told Fox News that American fighter jets used precision munitions on an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island on Tuesday, in response to IRGC aggression against US personnel. It came hours after Tehran claimed to target a US radar at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa base; CENTCOM says the Iranian drones were all intercepted.

featured.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
featured.rewrite: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
featured.summary: Quarterly sales doubled to $115.8bn and profit to $65bn, and shares rose almost 4% after hours. Chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Huang, hours after he said he would be 'honoured' to return; interim CEO Colette Kress said it is 'business as usual'.

featured.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
featured.rewrite: TRUMP: U.S. TAKING IRAN DIRTY BOMB PLOT REPORT 'VERY SERIOUSLY'... 'WE'RE LOOKING INTO IT'
featured.summary: Asked in Manila about a CNN report that Iran planned a dirty bomb attack on Washington, Trump said 'We're looking into it' and that the US takes it 'very seriously'. The White House says there are no credible threats to the homeland at this time, and Iran calls the claim baseless.

featured.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
featured.rewrite: PUTIN'S CRIMEAN BRIDGE PARTLY COLLAPSES AFTER UKRAINE STRIKE
featured.summary: Images from Ukrainian officials show a section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the water after what Zelensky called an 'unprecedented operation'. The Kremlin says it will rebuild the road and rail link 'better than before'.

featured.title: JD Vance says he and Trump still 'don't know' whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy
featured.rewrite: VANCE: WE STILL 'DON'T KNOW' IF ALICE HUANG WAS A CHINESE SPY... INTEL 'POINTS IN DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS'
featured.summary: Vance told Fox's Laura Ingraham the intelligence on Alice Huang 'points in different directions', so neither he nor Trump can say whether she spied for China. US officials suspect she was recruited to push Nvidia to make advanced chips more available to Beijing, the New York Times reported. Trump backs a possible return for ex-CEO Jensen Huang.

left.title: DC Circuit weighs Trump’s takeover of two agencies after Supreme Court agency head removal ruling
left.rewrite: DC Circuit weighs Trump's takeover of two agencies after Supreme Court agency head removal ruling
left.summary: A federal appeals court heard two cases on Tuesday over the administration's takeover of two government agencies. They are among firing cases courts had paused while the Supreme Court weighed Trump's removal powers last term.

left.title: White House blasts 'Trumpcare for All' pitch from far-left El-Sayed who called president 'unserious fool'
left.rewrite: White House blasts 'Trumpcare for All' pitch from far-left El-Sayed who called president 'unserious fool'
left.summary: The White House attacked Abdul El-Sayed's 'Trumpcare for All' pitch, warning his Medicare for All plan would threaten the health coverage Americans already have.

left.title: Iranian ‘dirty bomb’ threat fails to move Democrats off demands to defund war
left.rewrite: Iranian 'dirty bomb' threat fails to move Democrats off demands to defund war
left.summary: Concerns that Iran could be plotting an attack on Washington haven't persuaded Democrats to give Republicans and the Trump administration more money for the Pentagon and the war against Tehran.

left.title: Vance’s midterm blame game hits snag as Trump’s own Israel ambassador disputes key claim
left.rewrite: Vance's midterm blame game hits snag as Trump's own Israel ambassador disputes key claim
left.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee rejected Vance's claim that Israel cost Republicans the midterms, blaming voter apathy and low evangelical turnout for the defeat instead.

left.title: Eric Adams eviscerates Mamdani for gutting NYPD's counter-terrorism unit
left.rewrite: Eric Adams eviscerates Mamdani for gutting NYPD's counter-terrorism unit
left.summary: Former mayor Eric Adams warned that dismantling the NYPD's Strategic Response Group would put lives at risk. Mamdani announced on Monday that the unit would be replaced by non-uniformed civilians trained in de-escalation.

left.title: Warren grills Trump Navy secretary on cost of Iran war: 'You don't have any idea?'
left.rewrite: Warren grills Trump Navy secretary on cost of Iran war: 'You don't have any idea?'
left.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren pressed acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao on what the Iran war blockade is costing. He dodged the questions and urged funding to reach a 355-ship fleet.

left.title: Thune weighs pre-Thanksgiving push to advance new Pentagon funding
left.rewrite: Thune weighs pre-Thanksgiving push to advance new Pentagon funding
left.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune is weighing a first vote on tens of billions in new Pentagon funding before senators leave for Thanksgiving. Republicans want to use their final weeks in control of Congress after losses in the midterm elections.

left.title: California prosecutors sue to block Newsom’s plan to commute all death sentences
left.rewrite: California prosecutors sue to block Newsom's plan to commute all death sentences
left.summary: A coalition of prosecutors, police groups and murder victims' relatives has asked the California Supreme Court to stop Gov. Gavin Newsom commuting all 548 death sentences in the state. They accuse him of abusing his clemency power and sidelining victims' families.

left.title: Fed Governor Lisa Cook threatens to skip ‘unfair’ hearing in scathing letter to White House
left.rewrite: Fed Governor Lisa Cook threatens to skip 'unfair' hearing in scathing letter to White House
left.summary: Fed Governor Lisa Cook has written to the White House calling the planned hearing on her removal unfair and threatening not to attend. The Supreme Court ruled in June that Trump cannot fire a Fed governor at will but may do so for cause if she gets a chance to defend herself.

left.title: Conservatives launch $10M anti-socialism blitz after Democrats dominate youth vote
left.rewrite: Conservatives launch $10M anti-socialism blitz after Democrats dominate youth vote
left.summary: Young America's Foundation is launching a $10 million 'Freedom Not Socialism' campaign in 30 Democratic strongholds. It follows Democrats winning most of the youth vote in the midterms.

left.title: Vance likens Democrats’ 2026 themes to Trump’s in pitch to el Sayed: ‘Let’s work together’
left.rewrite: Vance likens Democrats' 2026 themes to Trump's in pitch to el Sayed: 'Let's work together'
left.summary: Vance offered Michigan Sen.-elect Abdul el Sayed an olive branch, comparing Democrats' 2026 campaign message to Trump's in 2024 and suggesting the two sides work together.

left.title: Van Hollen: Midterms Were a 'Complete Rejection of Trump's Terrible Policies'
left.rewrite: Van Hollen: Midterms Were a 'Complete Rejection of Trump's Terrible Policies'
left.summary: On MS NOW's 'All In', Sen. Chris Van Hollen (D-MD) said the recent midterm elections were a 'complete rejection' of President Trump's 'terrible policies'.

left.title: DOJ official invokes 2020 Lindsey Graham case amid Democrats’ subpoena threats
left.rewrite: DOJ official invokes 2020 Lindsey Graham case amid Democrats' subpoena threats
left.summary: A senior Justice Department official warned Democratic lawmakers that their oversight threats may not be fully shielded from criminal subpoenas, pointing to a Supreme Court dispute involving the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.

left.title: Abdul El-Sayed Faces Heightened Scrutiny Over Photos With Nazi-Linked Activist
left.rewrite: Abdul El-Sayed Faces Heightened Scrutiny Over Photos With Nazi-Linked Activist
left.summary: Scrutiny of Democrat Abdul El-Sayed grew after a photo surfaced of him smiling with Kelly Neumann, a Michigan personal injury lawyer and Democratic fundraiser whose grandfather served in Hitler's military. The Free Beacon says the controversy escalated this week.

left.title: Watchdog group files ethics complaint over Thomas Massie’s failed Hegseth impeachment effort
left.rewrite: Watchdog group files ethics complaint over Thomas Massie's failed Hegseth impeachment effort
left.summary: A watchdog group has filed an ethics complaint against Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) over his failed bid to impeach War Secretary Pete Hegseth. The complaint argues the effort improperly targeted Hegseth for actions taken by President Trump.

left.title: Ashley Moody suggests NYPD officers from disbanded unit join Florida’s law enforcement agencies
left.rewrite: Ashley Moody suggests NYPD officers from disbanded unit join Florida's law enforcement agencies
left.summary: Sen. Ashley Moody (R-FL) suggested officers from the NYPD's Strategic Response Group look at jobs with Florida law enforcement. Mayor Zohran Mamdani disbanded the unit, which handled protest response, on Monday.

left.title: These Republicans are holding up Trump's judicial appointments
left.rewrite: These Republicans are holding up Trump's judicial appointments
left.summary: The Senate has confirmed only 58 of Trump's second-term judicial nominees, against 234 appointments in his first term, including three Supreme Court justices. The Blaze names the Republicans it says are holding up confirmations as Trump pushes to add more before Democrats take control of Congress in January.

left.title: Ro Khanna calls for $1,700 Iran war ‘refund checks’ in first week of Democratic majority
left.rewrite: Khanna wants $1,700 Iran war 'refund checks' in first week of Democratic majority
left.summary: The California Democrat says every American should get the rebate once Democrats retake Congress in 2027. 'Now Democrats have a chance to deliver,' he said in a statement on Monday.

left.title: Thomas Calls On SCOTUS To Assess Restrictions On Guns In ‘Sensitive Places’
left.rewrite: Thomas Calls On SCOTUS To Assess Restrictions On Guns In 'Sensitive Places'
left.summary: Justice Clarence Thomas urged the Supreme Court to review state bans on carrying guns in 'sensitive places'. He wrote that he harbours 'serious doubts' the nation's history of firearm regulation supports many of the sweeping restrictions.

left.title: Justices Thomas and Alito slam high court for rejecting challenge to ‘implicit bias’ training for doctors
left.rewrite: Thomas, Alito dissent as Supreme Court refuses challenge to California 'implicit bias' training for doctors
left.summary: The court declined on Monday to hear the free-speech challenge to California's mandatory training for medical licence renewals. Justice Clarence Thomas led the dissent.

left.title: Trump stands by Duffy and Lutnick after FAA ground stop and Nvidia controversies
left.rewrite: Trump stands by Duffy and Lutnick after FAA ground stop and Nvidia spy scandal... GOP scrutiny of Lutnick grows
left.summary: Trump is backing both secretaries, but congressional Republicans are increasingly questioning Lutnick over his decision to delay restrictions on the company linked to the Chinese spy at the centre of the Huang affair. Duffy is under fire over last week's nationwide FAA ground stop.

left.title: Mamdani disbands counter-terrorism and riot response unit
left.rewrite: MAMDANI DISBANDS NYPD COUNTER-TERROR AND RIOT UNIT... CIVILIANS TO TAKE OVER PROTEST ROLE
left.summary: The mayor announced the end of the Strategic Response Group in a video on Monday, saying counterterrorism and protest response 'should be separated'. A new community dialogue and de-escalation division in the Mayor's Office of Community Safety will use non-uniformed civilians; police unions blasted the move.

left.title: Sanders endorses Van Hollen for Senate leader: ‘This is not a personality contest’
left.rewrite: Sanders endorses Van Hollen over Schumer: 'This is not a personality contest'
left.summary: The Vermont independent says the party needs a new direction after its sweeping midterm win. His backing boosts Van Hollen's challenge for Senate Democratic leader.

left.title: Washington Supreme Court considers $20 bail for some crimes
left.rewrite: Washington Supreme Court considers $20 bail for some crimes
left.summary: Washington state's Supreme Court is weighing proposals that would set bail as low as $20 for some crimes. Critics say the plan amounts to a sweeping overhaul of pretrial detention that is likely to hurt public safety in cities.

left.title: Forensic expert says his analysis raises doubts about how Epstein died
left.rewrite: Forensic expert tells BBC Epstein's injuries 'consistent with a homicide'
left.summary: Professor Michael Freeman told BBC Newsnight he reviewed the New York City medical examiner's file and believes Epstein's death in prison was homicide, not suicide. Epstein was awaiting trial on sex-trafficking charges when he was found dead in his cell.

left.title: Almost half a million people signed on to unemployment benefits without any obligation to look for work in the last year
left.rewrite: Almost half a million people signed on to unemployment benefits without any obligation to look for work in...
left.summary: More than four million people were on Universal Credit with no work requirements in August, up 486,000 in a year, the latest data shows.

left.title: Landmark youth unemployment report suggests Labour's policies are to blame for jobs crisis
left.rewrite: Landmark youth unemployment report suggests Labour's policies are to blame for jobs crisis
left.summary: Alan Milburn's review of youth worklessness says Labour made the jobs market harder for young people in its first two years, citing tax rises and above-inflation increases to the youth minimum wage. Milburn is a former Labour health secretary.

left.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
left.rewrite: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
left.summary: The Supreme Court declined to hear Custodia Bank's appeal, so a lower-court ruling letting the Federal Reserve reject its account application stands. The bank had sought direct access to the Fed's payment system.

left.title: Live: David Jones administrators meet with 500 creditors for first time
left.rewrite: David Jones administrators meet with 500 creditors for first time
left.summary: Administrators for department store David Jones held their first meeting with about 500 creditors. The ABC's live markets blog also reports the ASX opened in the red after all major Wall Street indexes fell.

left.title: Spanberger Wants Power Giants To Pay Customers $6.5 Billion Before They Can Merge
left.rewrite: Spanberger Wants Power Giants To Pay Customers $6.5 Billion Before They Can Merge
left.summary: Spanberger wants two utility giants to pay customers about $6.5 billion, equal to their merger's breakup fee, if regulators approve the deal. The payment would have to come before the merger can go ahead.

center.title: Moment gas tanker is completely consumed by flames after being 'hit by projectile while sailing through the Strait of Hormuz'
center.rewrite: Moment gas tanker is completely consumed by flames after being 'hit by projectile while sailing through...
center.summary: The crew of 25 abandoned the Panama-flagged LPG tanker off Khasab on Oman's coast, maritime security sources said.

center.title: Iranian foreign minister blames Israel for dirty bomb reports
center.rewrite: Iranian foreign minister blames Israel for dirty bomb reports
center.summary: Iran's foreign minister blamed Israel for reports that Tehran planned a dirty bomb attack in Washington and dismissed them as propaganda. The reports, first carried by CNN citing US intelligence, have not been independently verified.

center.title: Vance hits back at ‘neoconservatives’ advocating ‘forever’ war with Iran
center.rewrite: Vance hits back at 'neoconservatives' advocating 'forever' war with Iran
center.summary: Vance accused 'neoconservatives' criticising the administration's talks with Iran of pushing for a 'forever' war, which he said he and Trump want to avoid. Trump has pulled Vance from the Iran negotiations and told him to focus on rooting out fraud.

center.title: Imprisoned ex-Pakistan PM Imran Khan, 74, warns he 'may not return alive': British sons make plea
center.rewrite: Imprisoned ex-Pakistan PM Imran Khan, 74, warns he 'may not return alive': British sons make plea
center.summary: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan, 74 and jailed since 2023, has asked Pakistan's Supreme Court to let him be treated in a hospital in Islamabad, warning he may not come out alive.

center.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
center.rewrite: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
center.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis have forced the army of Yemen's internationally recognised government to pull back from the Red Sea coast to defend its interim capital, Aden. The BBC's security correspondent warns the advance bodes ill for the government and could have dangerous wider consequences.

center.title: Malaysia Is Accused of Playing 'Decisive Role' in Helping Iran’s ‘Shadow Fleet’ Evade US Oil Blockade
center.rewrite: Malaysia accused of 'decisive role' helping Iran's shadow fleet slip U.S. oil blockade
center.summary: A watchdog group's shipping data and satellite monitoring suggest Malaysia is helping Iran's ghost fleet get oil past the US naval blockade, generating cash for Tehran.

center.title: Putin, Xi and Trump will discuss 'world peace' in meeting this week - but Ukraine is off the table
center.rewrite: Trump, Xi, Putin to talk nuclear arms cuts and Iran this week... Ukraine off the table
center.summary: US officials say Trump wants to discuss reducing nuclear arsenals and raise the Iran war at the three-way meeting, but Russia's war in Ukraine is not expected to be discussed.

center.title: Trump says he ‘may meet’ North Korea’s Kim Jong Un in China
center.rewrite: TRUMP: I 'MAY' MEET KIM JONG UN IN CHINA... ALREADY SET FOR THREE-WAY SUMMIT WITH XI, PUTIN
center.summary: Trump said on Monday he 'may' see the North Korean leader during his upcoming China visit. The trip already includes a three-way summit with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin; Trump suggested Kim's presence is up to Xi.

center.title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
center.rewrite: Five EU countries to open migrant deportation 'return hub' in Rwanda
center.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands expect the centre for failed asylum seekers to accept transfers in 2027. The Dutch and Danish governments announced it as part of a wider push to boost removals.

center.title: South Africa shootings: 17 killed in Pietermaritzburg and Pretoria
center.rewrite: 17 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
center.summary: Eight men were shot dead in a minibus in KwaZulu-Natal on Sunday night, and hours later nine people were killed in a second attack in Gauteng. Police say about 60 people are murdered every day in South Africa.

center.title: Pauline Hanson unveils plan to scrap parent visas and slash refugee intake by 90 per cent
center.rewrite: Pauline Hanson unveils plan to scrap parent visas and slash refugee intake by 90 per cent
center.summary: One Nation says Australia can no longer afford its existing visa programs, and its policy would scrap parent visas entirely while cutting the humanitarian intake by 90 per cent.

center.title: Trump praises Albanese as Quad unveils defence and minerals deals
center.rewrite: Trump praises Albanese as Quad unveils defence and minerals deals
center.summary: At a Quad summit in Manila, Trump praised Anthony Albanese as the US, Australia, India and Japan agreed deals on defence, technology and critical minerals. The talks come ahead of major meetings in China.

center.title: Chalmers proposes rules to allow super to invest in housing, energy, startups
center.rewrite: Chalmers proposes rules to allow super to invest in housing, energy, startups
center.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is unveiling changes to the rules on what super funds can invest in, opening the way to riskier assets with possibly higher returns such as housing, energy and startups.

center.title: Chalmers says spending will be cut in mid-year update 'but not too much'
center.rewrite: Chalmers says spending will be cut in mid-year update 'but not too much'
center.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers confirmed a 'substantial' package of savings in the mid-year budget update, due in December, while saying the spending cuts will not go too far.

center.title: Live: Backpacker visa changes to be altered following backlash
center.rewrite: Backpacker visa changes to be altered following backlash
center.summary: The federal government has announced further changes to the backpacker visa scheme after a backlash from regional Australia.

center.title: Rudd-era mining tax could have boosted budget by $135b
center.rewrite: PBO: Rudd's scrapped mining tax could have boosted budget by $135 billion
center.summary: A Parliamentary Budget Office analysis finds the abandoned tax, which led to Kevin Rudd's 2010 toppling, would have improved the budget by $135 billion.

center.title: Coalition leads Labor in new poll which spells wipeout for Albanese - with government on track to lose 40 seats
center.rewrite: Roy Morgan poll: Coalition leads Labor... government on track to lose 40 seats
center.summary: The new Roy Morgan poll puts the Coalition ahead of Labor and points to a wipeout for the Albanese government if an election were held today.

center.title: Penny Wong defends taxpayer-funded COP31 'the movie' starring Moana actress - as Chris Bowen and Anthony Albanese are criticised over luxury hotel
center.rewrite: Wong defends $3 million taxpayer-funded COP31 'movie' starring Moana actress
center.summary: The film cost taxpayers $3 million and aired at the UN climate summit. Foreign Minister Penny Wong defended the spending.

center.title: Australia backs Trump's AI alliance as US takes on China
center.rewrite: Australia signs on to Trump's AI alliance as U.S. takes on China
center.summary: Australia has signed a US-led AI supply chain agreement, moving closer to Washington as cheaper Chinese AI attracts interest across the region. Albanese told regional leaders they must 'shape AI' rather than the other way around.

center.title: Death of woman and toddler at Melbourne lake to be probed by coroner
center.rewrite: Death of woman and toddler at Melbourne lake to be probed by coroner
center.summary: Victoria Police say the deaths of a 36-year-old woman and a two-year-old child at a Craigieburn lake are not being treated as suspicious. A report will be prepared for the coroner.

center.title: Early voting begins in Victoria's biggest election ever
center.rewrite: Early voting begins in Victoria's biggest election ever
center.summary: Early voting is under way, with more than 4.7 million Victorians enrolled to vote by November 28, the most on record. The scale is testing the Victorian Electoral Commission's processes.

center.title: Victorian election leaders’ debate as it happened: Ben Carroll, Jess Wilson, Warren Pickering and Ellen Sandell pitch to undecided voters
center.rewrite: Victorian election leaders' debate as it happened: Ben Carroll, Jess Wilson, Warren Pickering and Ellen...
center.summary: With 11 days to the election, Premier Ben Carroll and Opposition Leader Jess Wilson faced off in a four-way debate that also included the One Nation and Greens leaders.

center.title: Victorian Election 2026: Labor, Liberals, Greens and One Nation compared on every major issue
center.rewrite: Victorian Election 2026: Labor, Liberals, Greens and One Nation compared on every major issue
center.summary: 7News compares where Labor, the Liberals, the Greens and One Nation stand on the big issues, from toll caps and tax cuts to housing, health, crime and transport, ahead of the November 28 state election.

center.title: Big Build royal commission LIVE updates: Bikie Joel Leavitt appears as Gap Road witnesses continue after Ben Carroll expresses anger at government
center.rewrite: Big Build royal commission LIVE updates: Bikie Joel Leavitt appears as Gap Road witnesses continue after...
center.summary: The Big Build royal commission's first block of hearings is in its second week, with bikie Joel Leavitt appearing as a witness over the Gap Road project. The government has faced heavy criticism over its lack of cooperation with the inquiry.

center.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
center.rewrite: Fed's Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
center.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller pointed to the Binance hack as he asked who bears the losses from fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional assets move onto blockchains.

center.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
center.rewrite: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
center.summary: A fund run by a former OpenAI researcher sold out of bitcoin miners and cut its IREN stake by 94% after a portfolio slump. It swapped Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk shares for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

center.title: Anthropic gets a buy rating ahead of IPO this week. What this analyst expects from the AI giant
center.rewrite: Anthropic gets a buy rating ahead of IPO this week. What this analyst expects from the AI giant
center.summary: New Street Research started coverage of Anthropic with a buy rating and a $105 price target ahead of the AI company's expected IPO this week.

center.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
center.rewrite: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
center.summary: Judge Jessica Clarke ruled the brothers' trades involved no false promises. The ruling did not decide whether their conduct was ethical or broke other laws.

center.title: Reserve Bank boss Michele Bullock delivers tough message to mortgage holders after five rate hikes - saying she's more worried about renters
center.rewrite: Reserve Bank boss Michele Bullock delivers tough message to mortgage holders after five rate hikes -...
center.summary: Reserve Bank governor Michele Bullock issued a new warning to mortgage holders as business leaders raise the alarm about the economy.

center.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
center.rewrite: Bitcoin fails to hold $65K as U.S. stocks slide on AI nerves
center.summary: Bitcoin is around $64,300 after hitting $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since 14 July. Traders are weighing Nvidia's third-quarter earnings and Anthropic's IPO announcement.

center.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
center.rewrite: Strategy buys 485 Bitcoin for $33M... spends $228M buying back STRC shares
center.summary: The purchases were largely funded by new common stock sales.

right.title: Henry Nowak's killer Vickrum Digwa applies to appeal murder conviction
right.rewrite: Henry Nowak's killer Vickrum Digwa applies to appeal murder conviction
right.summary: Vickrum Digwa, serving at least 25 years for fatally stabbing 18-year-old Henry Nowak in Southampton, has asked the Supreme Court to review his murder conviction, his lawyers confirmed.

right.title: Council worker who removed protest flags from migrant camp in the middle of the night handed police order
right.rewrite: Council worker who removed protest flags from migrant camp in the middle of the night handed police order
right.summary: A council worker who took down protest flags and banners near the planned RAF Barnham migrant site at night has been handed a police order. The Home Office plans to house nearly 1,000 migrants at the former base.

right.title: Failed asylum seekers face removal without five-day notice period
right.rewrite: Failed asylum seekers face removal without five-day notice period
right.summary: The government will change the law so failed asylum seekers no longer get five working days' notice before removal; ministers say the notice leads to last-minute appeals. Under the proposed rules the Home Office would have six months to remove a person without telling them in advance.

right.title: Labour accused of being 'hell-bent' on opening Piddington migrant camp despite warnings it could cost taxpayers £1billion over a decade
right.rewrite: Labour 'hell-bent' on Piddington migrant camp despite warnings of £1 billion cost
right.summary: Housing secretary Angela Rayner approved the camp at MoD Bicester last week, even though nearby Piddington symbolically voted to leave the UK.

right.title: Labour's ban on zero-hours contracts 'could cost NHS and fire services billions of pounds'
right.rewrite: Labour's zero-hours ban 'could cost NHS and fire services billions'
right.summary: The warning targets Angela Rayner's new laws to end 'exploitative' employment arrangements.

right.title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
right.rewrite: No 10: Russell Brand 'not guilty' prison message 'appalling'... urgent investigation
right.summary: Brand, serving 10 and a half years for rape and three counts of sexual assault, had his wife read a message on their podcast saying he was 'not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for'. Downing Street says it is being urgently investigated.

right.title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham to say ahead of EU summit
right.rewrite: Burnham: 'The Brexit we were given has not worked'... UK lost more than it gained
right.summary: In a Lord Mayor's Banquet speech ahead of a UK-EU summit this week, the prime minister compares the Brexit deal to the 'emperor's new clothes' and says a 'needlessly hard Brexit' created barriers.

right.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
right.rewrite: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
right.summary: Beyond the estimate of up to 15,000 affected apps, independent audits have found hundreds of separate compatibility problems. Core developers will reconsider the changes on Thursday.

right.title: US government confirms investigation into tech firm Megaspeed
right.rewrite: US government confirms investigation into tech firm Megaspeed
right.summary: US officials confirmed they are investigating Singapore-based Megaspeed, which is suspected of helping ship high-end Nvidia AI chips to China in breach of US export rules.

right.title: The Chip Boss’s Bedroom Scandal Just Got A Date On Capitol Hill
right.rewrite: The Chip Boss's Bedroom Scandal Just Got A Date On Capitol Hill
right.summary: Jensen Huang will testify to Congress on Monday, December 1, in closed-door sessions, followed by Nvidia general counsel Tim Teter, according to a joint committee announcement.

right.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
right.rewrite: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
right.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group moved 34,279 ETH, about $63 million stolen from Binance, to three new wallets after two weeks of silence. Investigators say the funds haven't moved again since.

right.title: Mullin says expert blamed AI for tech outages as Duffy calls situation ‘head-scratcher’
right.rewrite: Mullin says expert blamed AI for tech outages as Duffy calls situation 'head-scratcher'
right.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said an unnamed tech expert told him artificial intelligence was behind the recent run of system outages. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy called the situation a 'head-scratcher'.

right.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
right.rewrite: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face attack
right.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, alleging it misled and endangered the public by testing AI agents without proper safeguards. He cites the July attack in which hundreds of OpenAI agents breached Hugging Face's systems. OpenAI says it is being singled out; it appears to be the first such suit by a US state.

right.title: US moves to stop AI chip-smuggling amid push to reinstate Huang
right.rewrite: US moves to stop AI chip-smuggling amid push to reinstate Huang
right.summary: Trump has added weight to a push to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO, days after he resigned amid fears of a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The ABC reports the US is also moving to stop AI chip smuggling.

right.title: Microsoft explains ‘root cause’ of global outage four days after fiasco
right.rewrite: Microsoft blames global outage on Wednesday glitches that exposed a summer software defect
right.summary: A top Microsoft executive said on Monday that technical difficulties starting Wednesday left systems vulnerable to a software defect discovered over the summer.

right.title: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty after release from secure hospital
right.rewrite: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty after release from secure hospital
right.summary: Arion Kurtaj, 21, admitted the Rockstar Games hack and other attacks he carried out as a teenager.

right.title: EXCLUSIVE: ICE Fights Back Against Public Scrutiny With New Automatic Bodycam Technology
right.rewrite: ICE rolls out bodycams that switch on together when one agent's camera activates
right.summary: Starting last week, when one agent's camera turns on, all cameras nearby activate too, three agency sources told The Daily Wire. The agency says the change is aimed at accountability amid hostile encounters.

right.title: Commerce Department issues rule limiting other countries' access to America's advanced AI chips
right.rewrite: Commerce issues rule limiting foreign access to America's advanced AI chips
right.summary: The interim rule, issued Monday, aims to stop export restrictions being sidestepped through remote computing at data centres in third countries. It follows Bessent's criticism that Commerce failed to restrict Megaspeed, the Nvidia customer at the centre of the Huang scandal.

right.title: Don Toliver Announces Sixth Album ‘Nitrous,’ Due Next Month
right.rewrite: Don Toliver Announces Sixth Album 'Nitrous,' Due Next Month
right.summary: 'Nitrous' is out December 4 on Cactus Jack/Atlantic. Toliver, who just received five Grammy nominations, recorded, produced and engineered it entirely himself.

right.title: Longtime Exec Howard Lee Departs as Skydance Confirms New Cable Structure and Division Name Under Channing Dungey
right.rewrite: Longtime Exec Howard Lee Departs as Skydance Confirms New Cable Structure and Division Name Under Channing...
right.summary: Skydance's merged cable networks will be called Skydance Global Cable Media, combining the Warner Bros. TV and US Networks groups under Channing Dungey, who also set out the new structure. Longtime executive Howard Lee is leaving.

right.title: Jeff Bezos Was ‘Heavily Involved’ in Casting Robert Pattinson as James Bond and Admits Initial Fears ‘Because He’s Already So Famous’
right.rewrite: Jeff Bezos Was 'Heavily Involved' in Casting Robert Pattinson as James Bond and Admits Initial Fears...
right.summary: Speaking at a Semafor event in Silicon Valley, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos said he was 'heavily involved' in Amazon MGM choosing Robert Pattinson as the next 007.

right.title: Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil to Headline When We Were Young 2027
right.rewrite: Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil to Headline When We Were Young 2027
right.summary: Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil will headline When We Were Young on October 16, 2027, as the festival returns to the Las Vegas Festival Grounds after a year off.

right.title: Peacock Reveals ‘The Traitors’ Season 5 Premiere Date, First Look
right.rewrite: Peacock Reveals 'The Traitors' Season 5 Premiere Date, First Look
right.summary: Peacock says 'The Traitors' Season 5 premieres Thursday, January 14, and released a first look. The cast includes Kristin Chenoweth, Dominic Monaghan, Joey Graziadei and Chloe Kim.

right.title: ‘Cliff Booth’ First Reactions: Brad Pitt’s Sequel Is an ‘Absolute Triumph’ and a ‘Wildly Entertaining’ ‘Love Letter’ to Hollywood
right.rewrite: 'Cliff Booth' First Reactions: Brad Pitt's Sequel Is an 'Absolute Triumph' and a 'Wildly Entertaining'...
right.summary: Critics who saw 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth', the Netflix-backed 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood' sequel from David Fincher, Brad Pitt and Quentin Tarantino, are calling it 'wildly entertaining'.

right.title: CAA and Hybe Launch Strategic Partnership
right.rewrite: CAA and Hybe Launch Strategic Partnership
right.summary: Creative Artists Agency and K-pop and lifestyle giant Hybe have launched a partnership to expand Hybe's creative and commercial opportunities.

right.title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Extended Cut Sets December Release Date in Theaters
right.rewrite: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Extended Cut Sets December Release Date in Theaters
right.summary: The extended cut of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', with footage previously left on the cutting-room floor, returns to theatres on Dec. 4. Tickets go on sale Nov. 19.

right.title: British actor Robert Pattinson named as new James Bond
right.rewrite: ROBERT PATTINSON NAMED NEW JAMES BOND
right.summary: Pattinson succeeds Daniel Craig, who left the role after 2021's No Time to Die. Amazon MGM's new film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, who worked with Pattinson on Dune.
